paragraphs: GPIO initialization sets pin PB0 to digital output to generate the 10-microsecond trigger pulse. Pin PB1 is configured as an input to capture the echo pulse duration using the pulseIn timing function.
The I2C1 peripheral interface initializes bus communications with the PCF8574 expander at address 0x27, enabling 4-bit data transfers to the HD44780 LCD controller with minimal pin overhead.
